scoring_justification: Recomputing lattice thermal conductivity requires full DFT + Phono3Py simulation; the verifier cannot rerun. 300K values are compared to paper gold with tolerance (±0.5 W/(m·K)). Temperature trend is verified structurally.

required.RhSi: object with keys PBEsol and PBE
required.RhSn: object with keys PBEsol and PBE

outputs.description: Lattice thermal conductivity at 300 K for RhSi and RhSn computed with PBEsol and PBE functionals.

Temperature dependence of PBEsol lattice thermal conductivity for RhSi and RhSn from 100 K to 500 K. The checker verifies that thermal conductivity decreases monotonically with increasing temperature.

output_contract.notes: Phonon dispersion and density of states are produced as intermediate outputs but are not scored. Solid-solution calculations are excluded from scope.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold 300 K thermal conductivity values (PBEsol and PBE, RhSi and RhSn) from the paper.
